texto: Good morning! Welcome to HubWork. Are you here for the global tech event?
Morning! Yes, I am. Actually, I’m here for the whole week.
Great! What’s your full name, please?
It’s Lucas Mendes.
Got it. And where are you from, Lucas?
I’m originally from Brazil, from São Paulo, but I’m in Toronto on business right now.
Nice! Is this your first time in Canada?
Yes, it is. The city is amazing, but it’s a bit cold for me today, to be honest!
Haha, it’s only ten degrees outside! What do you do, by the way? Are you a software engineer?
No, I’m not an engineer. I’m a product manager at an international fintech.
Awesome. Your visitor badge is ready. The Wi-Fi password is on the back, and coffee is free in the kitchen!
